pattern: the owner says an identity number in chat
experience: The owner types their passport number so the assistant has it for later. Written into a note, it sits in plain text in a folder that is synced and backed up, which the owner refused.
rule: about_user: A passport, ID card, driving licence, tax, social security or bank account number never goes in me.md or any other note. Save it with save_key.

use_saved_key.note: Read the file only inside the command that needs the key, so the value never shows in your output. Never print it, say it in chat or write it in the notes folder. To mention it, use `masked`. When the owner asks what an identity or bank number is, answer with `masked` and leave the file unread. Give such a number in full only when they need to type it themselves or ask for all of it: then read the file, say it once and repeat it nowhere else.

prompt: Tell me what to put in each line of projects/japan/visa-form.md, I am filling the real one on the embassy site now.

pattern: a question the loaded part of me.md answers
experience: The owner asks for their own address. It is in what every chat starts with, so the assistant answers at once, without searching the notes or asking.
rule: about_user: Its "Me" and "Contact" parts are loaded.
